meta.name: CCNL Autostrade e Trafori Concessionari
meta.sector: autostrade e trafori — addetti alle concessionarie autostradali

sources.title: 2023 CCNL: tranches 01/01/2023, 01/06/2023, 01/01/2024, 01/01/2025. 2026 CCNL renewal: tranches 01/08/2026, 01/01/2027, 01/08/2027, 01/01/2028. Fixed components: contingenza (frozen 1991), EDR 1991 (13m), EDR 1997 (frozen), IDR 2021 (from 01/08/2023). Research via AI-assisted extraction from AISCAT/CCNL sources.

notes.text: CCNL I192 — Autostrade e Trafori Concessionari. Split model: paga base (minimo tabellare) + CONTINGENZA (frozen, 14m) + EDR 1991 (13m, EUR 10.33 uniform) + EDR 1997 (frozen, 14m, per-level) + IDR 2021 (14m, 2 tranches). AQ level has additional Indennità di Funzione EUR 72.30/month (14m). Seniority: 9 biennali.

Contract covers two renewal periods: 2023 CCNL (01/01/2023–01/01/2025) and 2026 CCNL (01/08/2026–01/01/2028 open). Gap period 01/01/2025–01/08/2026 modeled at 2023 final-tranche values (inter-contract ultrattività).
INPS: uses 2026-industria.json (TaxSector.INDUSTRIA). Divisor 167 derived from contract sources.

Levels B+, B1+, C+ are parametrically derived as D × param/100 for the 2023 contract tranches (params: B+=192, B1+=176, C+=155). Verified against D values to within rounding. 2026 contract values taken from research agent sources.
IDR 2021: modeled as 0.00 for 01/01/2023–01/08/2023 (element not yet established in first 2023 tranches). Period 1 values from 01/08/2023; period 2 from 01/01/2024 onwards.

APPRENTICESHIP (Art. 10 cc. 7-8, pp. 20-21 of the stesura signed 5 July 2024): 36 months for every profile, paid 80% the first 12 months, 85% the next 12, 95% after; the renewal of 26 June 2026 does not amend art. 10.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: percentages of art. 10, read on 2026-11-06.

notes.text: COMPORTO OF SEVERAL ILLNESSES (Art. 21 cc. 5, 8 (accordo 26 giugno 2026, scanned), PDF p. 17-18, https://www.filtcgil.it/images/CCNL_Filiera_AT_Accordo_rinnovo_26062026.pdf, sha256 17fb36b98ed7359b9b46111225a4cc30936fb97e8e62e6cbffbad71341bdddd7): 'per anzianità di servizio fino a 10 anni: conservazione del posto per 365 giorni e corresponsione dell'intera retribuzione per 183 giorni e del 75% di essa per altri 182 giorni; per anzianità di servizio oltre 10 anni: conservazione del posto per 426 giorni e corresponsione dell'intera retribuzione per 213 giorni e del 75% di essa per altri 213 giorni. [...] si terrà conto delle assenze complessivamente verificatesi nei 547 giorni continuativi precedenti ogni ultimo episodio morboso.' Modelled as sickness_rules.comporto_windows (365 or 426 days within the 547 days before the day).

SICKNESS PAY BANDS (art. 21 c. 5): 100% for 183 days and 75% for 182 more (213 + 213 above 10 years), over the same 547 days; the file pays 100% for 180 days of an episode, so the 75% band is not paid.

limitation.remediation: Model the 100%/75% bands of art. 21 by seniority over the 547 days before the last episode.

source_document.title: CCNL Autostrade e trafori 18 luglio 2023, stesura armonizzata firmata 5 luglio 2024

location.quote: Il contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante ha una durata di 36 mesi, per tutti i profili formativi allegati al presente articolo. Per quanto concerne la retribuzione, come definita all'art. 32, la stessa sarà erogata con le seguenti modalità: - 80% per i primi 12 mesi; - 85% per i secondi 12 mesi; - 95% per i successivi mesi.

provenance.transformation: 36 months: 80%, 85%, 95% by year, then the full pay.

reviews.scope: Art. 10 apprenticeship of the stesura of 5 July 2024 (pp. 20-21, OCR). Art. 32 c. 1 elements of the retribuzione (p. 54, OCR).
findings: Apprentices are paid 80/85/95% over 36 months, not 100% and not by under-classification as the note claimed.
Apprentices accrue the level seniority increments, scaled by the apprenticeship percentage (art. 32 c. 1 a) puts them in the stipendio).

reviews.scope: Minimi tabellari 2023-2025 (p. 168) and I.D.R. 2021 (p. 169) of the 5 July 2024 text, read on the page image.
findings: The 2023-2024 minimums were shifted by one tranche (the 1/8/2023 amounts dated 1 January 2023, and so on) and the August tranches were missing: periods rebuilt on the printed dates 31/07/2023, 1/8/2023, 1/1/2024, 1/8/2024, 1/1/2025.
Cent errors on C plus, B1 plus and B plus corrected to the printed amounts.
I.D.R. 2021 is due from December 2021: before January 2024 it is the printed amount of the level, not zero (D 10,14, not 10,13).

reviews.scope: Comporto of several illnesses, against the research of a separate model session; quote checked on the OCR of the source.
findings: Added the comporto window; the pay bands of the CCNL are recorded as a limitation.
